summary: Iran's public land-management portal was inspected and its current JavaScript/configuration was followed to the same-origin API base. No anonymous Famenin parcel endpoint with a safe native ID and full polygon response was verified; no GeoJSON sample was retained.
queryOutcomes: English and Persian discovery queries, exact query text, outcomes, and actual URLs are recorded in city-3955-famenin.json under freshResearch.
requestOutcomes: All direct requests and their outcomes are recorded in city-3955-famenin.json under requestOutcomes. The public portal returned HTML and JavaScript, but no parcel layer/schema/CRS/ID+geometry route was identified. Registration-related hosts were timeout, DNS, or connection-reset cases and were not treated as absence.
scopeLimits: The WUP point [35.1198911619496, 48.9735870145821] was preserved exactly in latitude/longitude order.
No local Famenin registry/cadastre map or procedure was evidenced strongly enough for registryFound=true.
National registration and land-management evidence is not evidence of citywide Famenin open parcel coverage.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, personal, tax/account, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
No geometry was retained because native identity and complete polygon response were not verified.
A zero hit, extent miss, timeout, login wall, or unavailable UI would not prove citywide absence.
Packet completion is not source integration/admission; serial reviewer qualification remains required.
